Messages.Author: waltman's family computer
Messages.Body:
I know the ruling for Army of Rats is only 1 pool per turn, and Anarch
Revolts are all counted, but what about all the other cards, specifically
Aching Beauty, Camarilla Exemplary (which I have an inkling isn't
"stackable") and Flak Jackets (which I think is possible, if not silly.)?
-T!mmy, Malkavian Clan Monk

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


All cards are cumulative, in as far as allowed by card text.
The cards you list (Aching Beauty, Cam. Exemplary, Flak Jacket) are
each cumulative.
